verdict.rationale: Cline's docs describe a web-based task board (Kanban) that runs many agents in parallel with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains—directly matching the 'unified workspace for multiple agent sessions' story—plus cron scheduling via a hub and a shared core engine across CLI/Kanban/IDE plugins. However, all evidence is first-party docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of the task-board experience itself. Missing for 10: independent or community validation of the multi-agent Kanban workspace, and detail on cross-session visibility/coordination features an engineering-lead would need.
